title: Supersede reads the predecessor digest, says when the predecessor is on another branch, and checks the base entry when declared
description: Supersede reads the predecessor digest, says when the predecessor is on another branch, and checks the base entry when declared
acceptance_criteria: supersede without --digest records the predecessor's signed entry digest for the path; a predecessor no change here records is refused as not in this branch's history with the merge or rebase step; when the predecessor's entry no longer matches the successor's base, supersede still records the obligation and warns, naming the commit that changed the file and the reconcile-history alternative
